blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza formally assumed leadership of the Bureau of Customs (BOC) on Thursday, after serving for a year as commissioner of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR). Appointed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Mendoza took his oath of office on Nov. 13. He brings to his new position experience in customs operations, revenue administration, and public sector reform, having also served as undersecretary for the Revenue Operations Group of the Department of Finance (DOF).
